changes: validate-lint.ts now accepts an optional, additive changedFiles change-scope (threaded checkLint->runTsc). When provided, tsconfigs whose package subtree contains no changed file are out-of-scope; an out-of-scope tsconfig whose package lacks node_modules is reported skipped-with-warning ([lint] skipped: <tsconfig> (out of scope, deps absent)) instead of hard-failing on frontend TS2307. New exports: resolveChangedFiles (injectable git diff --name-only main...HEAD reader, fail-open to full recursive on error), computeOutOfScopeTsconfigs (fail-closed: unmapped changed file => all in-scope), isPathUnderDir, packageHasNodeModules. Wired into verifier.ts (--lint --story) and review-preflight.ts (REVIEW->TEST preflight). No scope provided => unchanged full recursive tsc (B-5a28 preserved). New regression smoke validate-lint-change-scope-smoke.ts uses the CommandRunner DI seam (never spawns real tsc), registered in both package.json files.
usage: Backend-only change in a fresh worktree: lattice validate --lint --story=B-xxx now type-checks only the changed packages and skips out-of-scope packages that lack node_modules, instead of failing on unrelated frontend missing-dep errors. Plain lattice validate --lint (no --story) still recursively type-checks every tsconfig. Immediate operational fix for missing deps remains npm install (CLAUDE.md F-003); this is the framework-side scoping improvement.
expectedOutcome: lattice validate --lint --story=B-a749 for a backend-only change prints [lint] pass: tsc and reports the out-of-scope frontend tsconfig as skipped (out of change scope / deps absent) instead of [lint] fail: tsc ... Cannot find module; plain --lint with no change-scope still type-checks every tsconfig recursively.
actualTranscript: Live (built dist) backend-only change, frontend deps absent: overall status: pass; tsc invoked only on backend/tsconfig.json; detail: [lint] pass: tsc (tsc: checked 1 of 2 tsconfigs (1 skipped out of scope)); detail: [lint] skipped: frontend/tsconfig.json (out of scope, deps absent). No-scope (plain --lint): status=pass, tsc ran on [backend,frontend], output tsc: checked 2 tsconfigs. In-scope frontend change with a real injected tsc error: status=fail (gate bites). Smoke: node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-lint-change-scope-smoke.js -> ✓ validate-lint change-scope smoke passed, exit 0. lattice validate --story=B-a749: PASS, coverage 10/10.
outcomeDiff: No diff. Actual matches expected on all four axes: backend-only+deps-absent => pass with frontend skipped out-of-scope; no-scope => full recursive with legacy output preserved; in-scope real error => fail; tests never spawn real tsc.
limitations: Change-scope only activates when changedFiles is provided (verifier --story path and review-preflight story path); phase-gates.ts calls runReviewCliGates without injecting the reader, so it uses the real git default. Package-to-tsconfig mapping is by directory subtree (nearest-ancestor package.json for the node_modules probe); deeply nested or non-standard layouts fall back fail-closed to in-scope (checked, never silently skipped). Out-of-scope packages WITH node_modules present are still type-checked (defense-in-depth, not skipped).
pitfalls: Do NOT assume out-of-scope means never-checked: only out-of-scope AND node_modules-absent is skipped; in-scope packages always keep ENOENT(skip)-vs-nonzero(fail) semantics so the gate still bites on real errors. After merging main, verification evidence/delivery-check are signed against HEAD/material hashes — a code-changing merge can re-stale evidence (use verification_evidence_refresh_stale; metadata-only commits do not re-stale code evidence). The packages/main npm install fails on the unpublished @lattice-agent/lab workspace dep, but it is not imported in src — the worktree root node_modules is sufficient for tsc/build.
